{{Quote|We ran to see what was going on, and they hit us from behind. They took the box, and killed the Jedi.|Wojarra, providing an account of the Believer ambush in which Nysis Belzara was killed|<ref name="CD" />}}
'''Nysis Belzara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Belzara greeted a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] arriving on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was transporting a [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] box on behalf of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The Bothan was subsequently [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an ambush by the [[Believers]], [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith cult|cultists]] who sought to steal the vessel's cargo.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We landed and Es'Loma got out and walked to the edge of the platform. We were all getting out and then he arrived.|Wojarra, on Nysis Belzara's arrival at the Coruscant landing platform|<ref name="CD" />}}
Nysis Belzara was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], attaining the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="CD" /> Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] researchers discovered the [[Pulas]], a powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. To keep the relic out of the clutches of the [[Believers]], a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith cult|cult]] who sought to steal it, the Jedi arranged to relocate the artifact to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for safe keeping. A [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Starship/Legends|ships]] was assembled to ferry the relic, with each vessel carrying a [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] box, one of which contained the Pulas and the others acting as decoys. Belzara was tasked by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], the ruling body of the Jedi Order, with meeting one of the starships arriving on Coruscant and accompanying the crew and their [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] box to a safe house.<ref name="CD" />

The starship that Belzara was assigned to meet docked on a Coruscant [[Hangar/Legends|landing platform]] and just as the crew were disembarking, the Bothan arrived to greet them. However, one of the ship's company the, [[Tarasin]] [[Es'Loma]], was secretly in league with the Believers. The Tarasin pretended to fall from the edge of the platform, distracting Belzara and her fellow crew members, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Wojarra]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CD" /> [[Force Adept]]s<ref name="TRW">{{LivingForce|Eye of the Sun: The Resistance Within}}</ref> [[San Herrera]] and [[Nia Reston]], just as a Believer strike team attacked. Belzara was shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the ambush and the Believers seized the box that the ship had been transporting, which contained a fragment of the dark side-imbued [[City/Legends|city]] [[Conkesta]]. Moments later, the Jedi Knight [[Devan For'deschel]] and a [[Heroes of Cularin|group of spacers]] arrived at the landing platform; For'deschel recognized Belzara and contacted the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to notify them of the Bothan's demise, while Wojarra provided the spacers an account of Belzara's death.<ref name="CD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nysis Belzara was created by [[Morrie Mullins]] and featured in the [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'', which formed part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign and debuted at the fan convention [[Celebration II]]. Belzara's death takes place off-scene during the adventure and only his corpse appears directly in the roleplaying module.<ref name="CD" />
